The held text of EO 10587 also contains neighbouring EO 10586 and EO 10588 on the same Federal Register page; the neighbouring revocation of EO 8714 is not part of EO 10587. No earlier whole-order end found; the 'pending the discharge' language in EO 11086 sec. 3 means a residual role may have continued after 1963, so the reviewer should decide whether 12553 is the end or a clean-up.
